In summary, our research is concerned with
developing a reliable genetic map that will facilitate the identification of quantitative trait loci for drought tolerant and drought susceptible traits in a Mesoamerican common bean cross.
the genetic improvement of common bean for drought tolerance.
the development of a genetic map for the most important common bean genepool and the use of the map for the analysis of quantitative trait loci associated with important yield traits.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this study has produced a genetic map that can be used to detect QTLs for yield and yield components under drought stress and fully irrigated field conditions.
this is a useful and reliable common bean genetic map for QTL analysis and that this map can be utilized in future studies to identify QTLs for drought tolerance in common bean.

this is the most comprehensive map to date for the Mesoamerican common bean and that the map has been used to detect a number of QTL for important agronomic traits under drought stress and non-stress environments.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a genetic map was developed and used to detect quantitative trait loci for yield traits under drought conditions for the Mesoamerican  ×  Mesoamerican cross BAT477  ×  DOR364, which will be useful for future marker-assisted selection for drought tolerance.
we have developed the first reliable genetic map for the Mesoamerican bean genepool and have used this map to identify quantitative trait loci (QTL) for yield traits under drought conditions.

we have produced an accurate genetic map for the Mesoamerican common bean genepool that is suitable for QTL detection and that the genetic architecture of yield traits under both fully irrigated and rainfed conditions has been described.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the map developed is a valuable genetic resource for future QTL mapping in common bean.
the genetic map is saturated enough to be used to detect and fine map quantitative trait loci for drought tolerance in common bean.
the use of a reliable genetic map with SSR markers will be useful for the detection of QTLs in a Mesoamerican drought tolerant × susceptible cross.
